subject: SIG heatmap + OneTrust evidence grooming — CloudForge onboarding
messages:
From: Ellen Shaw <ellen.shaw@cloudforge.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: security@cloudforge.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG heatmap & evidence sprint planning for CloudForge OneTrust profile

Hi Stephanie / Ben,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is a first-pass SIG heatmap we generated from the questionnaire responses (cloudforge-sig-heatmap-20261101.xlsx). We highlighted ~18 controls where our answers are marked as "partial" or "evidence missing" — mostly around key management, incident telemetry, and backup verification.

Goals for the week:
- Confirm owners for the 18 partial controls (owner assertion + artifact path)
- Stage CAIQ fragments we already have (I included a small sample PDF)
- Get OneTrust minimal uploads live so your portal shows progress for the procurement review

Would you have 30 minutes tomorrow to align on ownership and a minimal evidence sprint? I can join the OneTrust session if helpful.

Attachments: cloudforge-sig-heatmap-20261101.xlsx, caiaq-fragment-examples.pdf

Thanks,
Ellen Shaw
Sr. Security Program Manager
CloudForge


From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Shaw <ellen.shaw@cloudforge.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG heatmap & evidence sprint planning for CloudForge OneTrust profile

Ellen —

Appreciate the heatmap and the quick CAIQ sample. We can run a focused grooming sprint this week. Proposed plan:

1) Ownership loop (today): Ben to draft owner assertions for controls in the "partial" bucket. Rishi to surface any SOC 2 artifacts we already have mapped to those controls.
2) OneTrust staging (tomorrow): I’ll create the minimal upload manifest and share temporary creds so CloudForge can verify uploads.
3) Evidence sprint (Wed–Fri): 2-day sprint to collect and attach artifacts; 1 day for QA and notes for procurement.

Ben — can you take the list in tab A of the heatmap and add an "owner assertion" column with who at Redwood is responsible (name + email) and where the artifact will live (Drive path or S3)? Aim to have that by EOD today.

Ellen — we’ll need a short writeup from you for any control where CloudForge requires us to accept responsibility for a sub-control (i.e., shared-responsibility clarifications). If you can flag those in the heatmap, that will speed the sprint.

I’ll schedule the 30min kickoff for tomorrow 11:00–11:30 PT and send a OneTrust invite.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

--

Date: 2026-11-01T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG heatmap & evidence sprint planning for CloudForge OneTrust profile

Stephanie / Ellen —

Quick update: I pulled the heatmap and started populating an "owner assertion" column. Most of the infra controls map to our infra team (Marcus/Lukas); app-level telemetry items map to Rishi. I added a notes column where we can mark whether an artifact is "internal-only" (SOC 2 report section) or "uploadable" to OneTrust.

I uploaded two files to the shared Drive:
- /CloudForge-Evidence/2026-11/owner-assertions-draft.xlsx (owner assertions + artifact paths)
- /CloudForge-Evidence/2026-11/onetru st-upload-log.txt (preflight for uploads — includes file hashes and minimal metadata)

Attachment: owner-assertions-draft.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

I also noticed CloudForge flagged BC-2 (backup verification) as missing — Rishi, is there a short snapshot we can provide (S3 lifecycle/backups manifest)? If not, I can draft a limited statement describing our backup verification cadence for procurement.

Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

> On Nov 1, 2026, at 10:03 AM, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com wrote:
> > Ellen —

From: Ellen Shaw <ellen.shaw@cloudforge.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG heatmap & evidence sprint planning for CloudForge OneTrust profile

Thanks — this looks great.

Quick notes after reviewing your uploads and the draft owner assertions:
- Owner assertions file: perfect. Please lock the final version after the sprint so procurement can reference the canonical doc.
- For BC-2: a short manifest showing successful backup jobs for the last 30 days plus a brief narrative is sufficient for our initial intake.
- OneTrust uploads: I verified the upload log; a couple of filenames failed SHA256 validation (likely character encoding in the export). I attached a small debug log with the failed keys.

Next steps:
- Stephanie: after your sprint QA, can you send me the finalized owner assertions and OneTrust manifest link?
- Ben: please drop the backup manifest (or the draft narrative) into /CloudForge-Evidence/2026-11 and ping me.

We’ll move the profile from "In progress" to "Ready for procurement review" once the artifacts are verified. If anything blocks the sprint, flag it in JIRA SUP-4521 and I’ll escalate.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Ellen
--
